# 1. Dynamic Imperial Style — Byzantium / Rome
oe_flv.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_senate_consistorium.dds"
	title = oe_flv.1.t
	desc = oe_flv.1.d

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_ROMAN_EMPIRE
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_ROMAN_EMPIRE_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.1.b
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		trigger = {
			government_type = government_type:republic
		}
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_SPQR
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_SPQR_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.1.c
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		trigger = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			owns = location:rome
		}
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_ECUMENICAL_ROME
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_ECUMENICAL_ROME_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.1.cancel
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		remove_variable = oe_flv_style_cd
	}
}

# 3. Dynamic Imperial Style — Muscovy / Russia
oe_flv.3 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_rus_boyarduma.dds"
	title = oe_flv.3.t
	desc = oe_flv.3.d

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.3.a
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_MUSCOVY
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_MUSCOVY_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.3.b
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = RUS
				num_locations >= 60
			}
		}
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_ALL_RUS
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_ALL_RUS_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.3.c
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = RUS
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
			}
		}
		change_country_name = OE_NAME_RUSSIAN_EMPIRE
		change_country_adjective = OE_NAME_RUSSIAN_EMPIRE_ADJ
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.3.cancel
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		remove_variable = oe_flv_style_cd
	}
}

# 10. First Via Imperialis Completed (zero-slot road on_built callback)
oe_flv.10 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_diplomacy.dds"
	title = oe_flv.10.t
	desc = oe_flv.10.d

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.10.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		add_prestige = 12
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler = yes
				ruler = {
					adm >= 40
					NOT = { has_trait = oe_trait_porphyrogenitus_scholar }
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				add_trait = trait:oe_trait_porphyrogenitus_scholar
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.10.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_stability = 3
		add_prestige = 6
	}
}

# 12. First Siberian Trakt Completed (zero-slot road on_built callback)
oe_flv.12 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_maritime_silk_road.dds"
	title = oe_flv.12.t
	desc = oe_flv.12.d

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.12.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		add_prestige = 12
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					is_general = yes
					mil >= 40
					NOT = { has_trait = oe_trait_siberian_pathfinder }
				}
			}
			random_character = {
				limit = {
					is_general = yes
					mil >= 40
					NOT = { has_trait = oe_trait_siberian_pathfinder }
				}
				add_trait = trait:oe_trait_siberian_pathfinder
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_flv.12.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_stability = 3
		add_prestige = 6
	}
}
